limits: Mac melonDS DS1.3.1 software renderer/builtin BIOS; isolated HG-derived project progress, not fresh HG/SS stories or universal save interchange.

Each gift fixture changes 12 unused script-stack bytes and a four-byte script pointer. Native GiveEgg creates the valid Togepi; no Pokemon, coordinates, cycles, hatch results or save flags are injected. Original follower continuation can run its native dialogue/event effects.
Source saves retain the explicitly declared earlier native legendary-release/location/ball-supply fixture ancestry; no such Pokemon data is edited here.

Original daycare, selector, calendar and ability instructions execute with controlled external services for breeding/notification/multiple/bad-egg tests. Full actual daycare breeding and additional species/egg sources remain pending.

Five-step counter covers eligible native daycare updates. Native transitions/other earlier step events can precede the update; cycling/Surf/forced movement and event/transition edges need wider acceptance.
Native naturally ready eggs can still hatch earlier; normal calendar/FlameBody/MagmaArmor rules remain. Session counter is not saved, matching the Emerald source static counter.
Private getters preserve every Pokemon byte and native stat block. No inspection mutates emulator state, input RAM or cartridge saves.
Other unfinished enhancements and wider acceptance remain in the full goal. These are experimental candidates, not final releases.
